gloss_en: SketchUp IFC4 export yields only one IfcBuildingElementProxy despite a classified Outliner hierarchy.
title_original: IFC4 Export from Sketchup2023 Pro
question_paraphrase: Built a simple model with IfcProject/Site/Building/Storey in the Outliner, classified everything, exported and got a single proxy. Which viewer is best, IFC2x3 or IFC4, how to validate?
phrasing_notes: plain narrative, several numbered questions at the end
answer_summary: A component named PROJECT (the model itself) broke the tree; IfcProject is created on export. Use components not groups, try IFC Manager; BIMcollab Zoom, Trimble Connect, BIMvision read it fine.

gloss_en: Need IfcProjectedCRS (EPSG:2326 Hong Kong grid) in SketchUp IFC export; geolocation gives wrong global coordinates.
title_original: How to export IFC files from SketchUp 2024 including IfcProjectedCRS
question_paraphrase: Need CRS info in IFC from SketchUp, is there a plugin or free tool? After adding via IfcOpenShell, global X/Y/Z are ~8 million m in BIM Vision.
answer_summary: Keep local origin near the project, add georeferencing afterwards via projected CRS (georeference-ifc, TU Delft web tool); request for offset option like DWG export.

gloss_en: IFC Manager export opens in Revit at one third scale (metre read as foot) when SketchUp units are metres.
title_original: Ifc export wrong scale
question_paraphrase: Revit users say the model comes in at about 1/3 size, like 1m became 1ft; some get an empty file. Switching SketchUp units to mm avoids it.
answer_summary: Bug in IFC Manager length unit definition fixed in v4.3.1; empty view may be view range; use single IfcSite/IfcBuilding for Revit/Archicad.

gloss_en: Exporter is not BIM-ready: no custom Psets, entities or relationships written, only proxy geometry with GUIDs.
title_original: SketchUp IFC export is not BIM-ready
question_paraphrase: Exported file has only geometry, IfcBuildingElementProxy, GUIDs and geolocation; Ruby metadata is dropped; unusable for compliance checking in Solibri/CodeCheck.
phrasing_notes: strong claims, lists of missing IFC items; reply disputes
answer_summary: Trimble says custom Psets, IfcRelDefinesByProperties and IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure are exported; IFC4x3 and CRS planned later; offers to inspect shared model.

gloss_en: SketchUp IFC opens in ArchiCAD as non-editable faceted B-rep; can plugins output extruded profiles?
title_original: IFC Structural model export from Sketchup to ArchiCAD and use it for BIM process
question_paraphrase: Elements show but cannot be edited in ArchiCAD; I think SketchUp writes IFCFACETEDBREP not extrusions. Plugins or script to change that?
answer_summary: SketchUp has no parametric history so no IfcExtrudedAreaSolid; try Tessellation vs Body (B-rep) options or IFC Manager; map to Morph in ArchiCAD translator.

gloss_en: Built-in export ignores custom attributes and base quantities; how to carry material and beam profile to structural software.
title_original: Export to IFC with IfcBaseQuantities
question_paraphrase: IFC export ignores custom properties; can dynamic component attributes carry material and beam profile for structural analysis?
answer_summary: Use IFC Manager plus a quantities extension; cross-section shape properties still not written automatically.

gloss_en: 600 MB model exports to IFC with geometry not matching SketchUp across several viewers.
title_original: Corrupt IFC Export
question_paraphrase: 600MB model from a Bentley IFC, many unique components grouped and tagged; exported IFC differs from the view in all viewers and cannot be re-imported.
phrasing_notes: states file size and workaround attempts
answer_summary: Round-trip via Trimble Connect to TrimBIM then into SketchUp; asked for file link and goal.

gloss_en: VisualARQ IFC export is in the wrong place for a Lambert 93 project; geometry near origin appears far away.
title_original: Export georeferenced IFC file
question_paraphrase: Exported IFC does not land in correct georeference for EPSG:2154; model sits near Rhino origin.
phrasing_notes: French-speaking user writing English, specific EPSG
answer_summary: VisualARQ exports relative to Origin of Coordinates not base point; workarounds: edit IFC origin, GH move, IFC Toolbox; Revit still misaligned.

gloss_en: Can an IFC be opened, edited and re-saved in Rhino without losing information?
title_original: IFC round-tripping
question_paraphrase: Resaved file shows a different tree and levels in BIMCollab Zoom. Can I edit only parts via Grasshopper/GeometryGym?
answer_summary: Round-tripping loses/changes data (spheres, SubD, units, hierarchy); test in several viewers.

gloss_en: Export UserText key-values as grouped custom property sets instead of one default Properties heading.
title_original: Export IFC from Rhino with custom properties
question_paraphrase: UserText exports only under a default Properties heading; I want sets such as location.
answer_summary: Use IfcTemplatePath document user text pointing to an IFC property set template, or | delimiter in keys.

gloss_en: Geometry Gym export fails: No IfcProject Classification found on nominated Layer.
title_original: Problem Exporting from Rhino 8 to IFC
question_paraphrase: Following tutorial with Site as IfcProject and sublayer as IfcSite, mesh export errors out.
answer_summary: Make the IfcProject layer active or export from its right-click menu.

gloss_en: Cannot import IFC in Rhino 8; an AI said McNeel has an IFC manager.
title_original: IFC for Rhino8
question_paraphrase: Rhino did not recognize the file; AI claimed built-in IFC export manager. Which is right? Opinion on IfcHopperShell?
phrasing_notes: mentions AI hallucination as the reason for asking
answer_summary: Rhino has no native IFC; use VisualARQ or GeometryGym via Package Manager; no free option known.

gloss_en: Import IFC in Grasshopper so repeated curtain-wall parts become shared nested block instances.
title_original: Grasshopper IFC import optimizations
question_paraphrase: Rhino native import gives few block definitions, my GH attempt hundreds; want GH example for curtain wall as nested blocks.
answer_summary: McNeel staff offers callable Rhino import method; counts ~96 vs 133 block definitions.

gloss_en: Masses exported as IfcBuildingElementProxy appear empty when IFC is opened in Revit 2022.
title_original: Importing IFC to Revit 2022 from Rhino shows no objects inside
question_paraphrase: IFC viewer shows masses, Revit 2020 shows them, Revit 2022 shows nothing, IFC4 and IFC2x3 both.
answer_summary: Use ggRevitIFC plugin which supports features Revit link/open misses.

gloss_en: Elements move after importing IFC parts into Revit via Geometry Gym.
title_original: Geometry Gym Revit, Elements change position after IFC-Import
question_paraphrase: Some elements shift after import; options changed with no effect.
answer_summary: Same GH script reused produces matching IDs; set separate ID pool per part.

gloss_en: How many elements are proxies?
prompt: how many things in this sketchup ifc are just IfcBuildingElementProxy? list by name
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, list names and groups, suggest proper IFC classes.

gloss_en: Check for IfcProjectedCRS and map conversion
prompt: does this file have IfcProjectedCRS / IfcMapConversion? what EPSG, and where is the site actually (global coords)?
expected_behavior: Read IfcProjectedCRS and IfcMapConversion, report EPSG, eastings/northings, and site placement; flag if absent.

gloss_en: Check units for 1/3 scale
prompt: revit guys say it comes in tiny. check the length unit in the ifc, metres or feet?
expected_behavior: Inspect IfcUnitAssignment/IfcSIUnit and conversion units, compare bounding box to expected size, advise fix.

gloss_en: Do custom Psets exist?
prompt: does the export actually contain my custom psets or just geometry? show all Pset names per element
expected_behavior: List IfcPropertySet names and properties per element via IfcRelDefinesByProperties; report empties.

gloss_en: Which reps are faceted brep
prompt: which elements are FacetedBrep vs extruded? archicad cant edit them
expected_behavior: Group elements by representation type (IfcFacetedBrep, IfcTriangulatedFaceSet, IfcExtrudedAreaSolid) and explain editability.

gloss_en: Extract volumes
prompt: pull NetVolume and GrossVolume for all walls and slabs, put in table, tell me which have no Qto
expected_behavior: Read Qto_*BaseQuantities, tabulate, list elements missing quantities.

gloss_en: Group usertext into psets
prompt: move all the loose Properties into a pset called Pset_Location for the site objects
expected_behavior: Create the property set, move/duplicate properties on selected elements, save new IFC and report.

gloss_en: Check storeys belong to the right building
prompt: freecad export, the levels are mixed up between the 2 buildings. check IfcRelAggregates and contained elements
expected_behavior: Walk IfcProject>Site>Building>Storey tree, find storeys with wrong parent or duplicate aggregates, report.

gloss_en: Do walls have openings
prompt: which walls have IfcOpeningElement? one wall should have a hole and it doesnt
expected_behavior: List walls with/without IfcRelVoidsElement and openings; flag walls lacking.

gloss_en: Compare two exports
prompt: compare v1 and v2 ifc, what elements changed added removed (by GlobalId)
expected_behavior: Diff by GlobalId, report added/removed/modified with property changes.

gloss_en: Reduce huge export
prompt: this ifc is 600mb, strip hidden stuff and split by storey so i can send it
expected_behavior: Identify heavy elements, remove invisible/empty objects, split by storey into separate files, report sizes.

gloss_en: Check materials
prompt: do the elements have materials or style assignments at all? list ones with none
expected_behavior: Report IfcRelAssociatesMaterial and IfcStyledItem coverage, list uncovered elements.

gloss_en: Can Rhino do IFC
prompt: i have rhino 8 but cant open ifc, whats the easiest way, free if possible
expected_behavior: Explain Rhino lacks native IFC; options VisualARQ, GeometryGym, BEAM, IfcOpenShell-based conversion; be honest about cost.

gloss_en: Why Speckle lost quantities
prompt: uploaded ifc to speckle but quantities missing, only psets. why
expected_behavior: Explain importer only extracts IfcPropertySet not IfcElementQuantity; suggest workaround via IfcOpenShell extraction.

gloss_en: Levels and elevations
prompt: list storeys with elevations and count of elements on each
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey with Elevation and contained element counts.
